title: How to Build a Wedding Timeline Around Light
description: Your photographs are only as good as the light you give them. How to plan a wedding day so the best hour is not spent cutting a cake indoors.
og_image_alt: Planning a wedding day timeline around available light
breadcrumb: How to build a wedding timeline around light

article.headline: How to build a wedding timeline around light
article.standfirst: There is one hour on your wedding day when photographs come out markedly better. Almost every schedule we are sent has something else booked in it.
